reconstruction.purpose: Delayed reconstruction and transfer benchmark on three source types without reopening the source or explainer during the delayed attempt.
reconstruction.delay_note: Two days is a project benchmark interval for repeatability, not a claim that two days is an optimal learning schedule.

source_decision.purpose: Calibrate consume / skim / explainer-is-enough / skip decisions against later full-source consumption on one case from each source type.

guardrails: The committed plan contains selection only; no human outcome, score, elapsed time or verdict is committed.
Reconstruction prompts are shown before scoring anchors so the benchmark does not reveal its own answer key during the attempt.
Source Decision calibration records are accepted only after the user explicitly confirms the original source was consumed.
All human observations are written under .local/ through the existing learning_utility and source_decision_benchmark stores.
Review status does not imply publication approval; review previews remain local/repository review surfaces.
